articles.title: Flight Canceled During the FAA Ground Stop? Here’s What to Do.
articles.que_paso: An FAA‑mandated ground stop has led to widespread flight cancellations and delays, leaving travelers with limited airline assistance because the cause is an air‑traffic‑control outage rather than airline fault. Passengers must navigate rebooking, refunds, and possible overnight stays without guaranteed amenities.
datos: Airlines must provide water and a snack within two hours of the start of a tarmac delay, unless safety or security issues intervene
Domestic flights have three hours to move the aircraft to a location where passengers can safely disembark
International flights have four hours for the same purpose
United Airlines, Delta Air Lines, and Alaska Airlines have issued waivers allowing travelers to change or cancel flights without incurring change fees or fare differences
Refunds are required for any canceled flight regardless of the reason, as well as for significantly delayed or changed flights if the passenger chooses not to travel
Travel industry analyst Jamie Larounis warned that the disruptions are likely to ripple into the weekend
articles.conclusion: Travelers should immediately use airline apps or lower‑traffic hotlines to secure alternative seats, book accommodations promptly, and rely on their statutory refund rights, as airlines are not obligated to provide hotels or meals during ATC‑related cancellations.

articles.title: Did the Redistricting Wars Backfire on Republicans? In a Word, No.
articles.que_paso: In the summer of 2025 Republicans redrew congressional districts aiming to secure a House majority in the 2026 midterm elections. The resulting election saw Democrats win overwhelmingly, capturing many seats the GOP had targeted. Despite the loss of targeted districts, Republicans still netted an estimated four to seven additional seats overall, with North Carolina being the only state where the effort may have slightly backfired.
datos: Republicans began redistricting in summer 2025
The target election was the 2026 midterm congressional races
Democrats won the election overwhelmingly, taking seats the GOP had aimed for
Preliminary analysis estimates Republicans gained between four and seven seats due to the new maps
North Carolina is identified as the sole state where the Republican redistricting may have backfired
articles.conclusion: The episode shows that aggressive redistricting can yield modest gains but does not guarantee control, highlighting the limited strategic value of map changes in a wave election environment.

articles.title: All Accounted for After Tanker Crashes Into Docked New Orleans Riverboat
articles.que_paso: A tanker collided with the docked riverboat American Heritage in New Orleans on Friday, capsizing the vessel and prompting a citywide rescue effort for the 197 people aboard.
datos: The collision occurred on Friday, November 14, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana.
The riverboat American Heritage was carrying 197 passengers at the time of the impact.
Mayor Helena Moreno confirmed that all 197 passengers were accounted for after the incident.
32 passengers were treated at local hospitals, with one reported as having serious injuries.
Governor Jeff Landry described the incident as a "literal miracle" during the news conference.
U.S. Coast Guard Sector New Orleans commander Capt. Melanie A. Burnham praised first responders for their dedication and professionalism.
articles.conclusion: The successful accounting of every passenger demonstrates the effectiveness of coordinated emergency response, underscoring the importance of preparedness in large‑scale operational incidents.

articles.title: Caos en los aeropuertos de EE UU por la suspensión de vuelos: “Nadie va a ir a ninguna parte”
articles.que_paso: La FAA suspendió todos los vuelos en territorio estadounidense el viernes por la tarde por "circunstancias extraordinarias y motivos de seguridad", dejando varados a miles de pasajeros en aeropuertos como JFK, Ronald Reagan y Harry Reid. La medida se anunció después de las 17:00 hora del Este y afectó tanto a vuelos programados como a itinerarios de conexión, generando incertidumbre y largas esperas en las terminales.
datos: La suspensión fue ordenada por la Agencia Federal de Aviación (FAA) bajo la justificación de seguridad y circunstancias extraordinarias
Más de 44.000 vuelos diarios transportan a más de 3 millones de pasajeros en EE UU, según la FAA
Hasta el momento se registran 4.301 vuelos domésticos cancelados, según Flightaware
La orden se emitió después de las 17:00 hora del Este y no afectó a los aviones que ya estaban en el aire
Un vuelo de Southwest que partía de Denver a San Diego logró aterrizar en Las Vegas, escapando a la suspensión
articles.conclusion: El colapso muestra la exposición del sistema de aviación a interrupciones regulatorias masivas, lo que obliga a reforzar planes de contingencia y alternativas de transporte para minimizar el impacto operativo.

articles.title: Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday
articles.que_paso: SpaceX launched Starship on its 15th test flight from Starbase, Texas, on Friday, deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites into orbit. The first‑stage booster aborted a planned landing, was diverted into the Gulf of Mexico and exploded, while the upper stage remains in orbit with a potential catch scheduled for Saturday.
datos: The launch took place on Friday, 14 November 2026, from Starbase, Texas.
It was Starship’s 15th test flight in more than three years.
26 Starlink V3 satellites were released about 40 minutes after liftoff, each with solar panels that extend to 60 m when fully deployed.
The first‑stage booster was commanded to divert into the Gulf of Mexico and exploded, observed from over 10 miles away.
If successful, the upper stage is slated to land at approximately 3:15 pm Central Time (21:15 UTC) on Saturday.
This was only the second time Starship has reached low‑Earth orbit.
articles.conclusion: The flight demonstrates Starship’s operational payload capability, but reusability is still unproven; a successful upper‑stage catch on Saturday would be a pivotal step toward rapid, low‑cost launch cycles for SpaceX.

articles.title: Airports Fill Up With Stuck Families and Stranded Travelers
articles.que_paso: On Friday afternoon the Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop, grounding flights at the United States' busiest airports. The shutdown left more than 1.5 million scheduled passengers stranded in terminals, including Chicago resident Frank Foto who risked missing a Saturday cruise from Miami.
datos: The FAA announced the ground stop on Friday, November 13, 2026.
Cirium reported that over 1.5 million passengers were scheduled to board flights after the stop was issued.
The stop affected all major U.S. airports, causing terminals and baggage claim areas to overflow with stranded travelers.
Frank Foto, a 34‑year‑old from Chicago, faced missing a cruise departing Miami on Saturday, November 14, 2026, for his mother‑in‑law’s 60th birthday.
articles.conclusion: The event exposes how a single regulatory action can disrupt massive passenger flows, emphasizing the need for robust contingency plans and real‑time data integration in airline and travel operations.

articles.title: Así se vació el cielo de Estados Unidos tras la suspensión de los vuelos
articles.que_paso: La Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA) emitió una orden de suspensión de todos los despegues en EE. UU. porque los centros de control de rutas presentaron una falla técnica, lo que paralizó el tráfico aéreo nacional. Esta medida afecta a todas las aerolíneas y a millones de pasajeros, generando interrupciones en la logística nacional.
datos: Orden emitida por la FAA el 14‑nov‑2026
Falla en los centros de guía de rutas que gestionan la navegación de aviones
Es la tercera interrupción de este tipo en la historia de EE. UU.
Incidentes previos: el 11‑septiembre‑2001 y el apagón informático de 2023
No se reportaron accidentes durante la suspensión
Se espera reanudación tras la restauración de los sistemas de guía
articles.conclusion: El cese total de vuelos muestra la vulnerabilidad de la infraestructura de control aéreo y obliga a planificar rutas alternativas y reservas de capacidad en la cadena de suministro.

articles.title: EEUU descarta la amenaza terrorista e insiste en un fallo de telecomunicaciones ante la suspensión de vuelos
articles.que_paso: El secretario de Seguridad Nacional, Markwayne Mullin, anunció que la paralización total de los vuelos en EE. UU. no responde a una amenaza terrorista. Señaló que la causa está relacionada con problemas de telecomunicaciones, aunque no especificó su origen.
datos: Markwayne Mullin, Secretario de Seguridad Nacional de EE. UU., emitió la declaración el 14 de noviembre de 2026.
Se suspendieron todos los vuelos comerciales y privados en territorio estadounidense.
Mullin descartó que la suspensión estuviera motivada por una amenaza terrorista.
Atribuyó la interrupción a problemas de telecomunicaciones.
No se proporcionó información sobre el origen de los fallos de telecomunicaciones.
articles.conclusion: Esto indica que la operatividad aérea puede verse comprometida por fallas de infraestructura de comunicaciones, por lo que las empresas deben reforzar planes de contingencia y monitorear la resiliencia de sus sistemas.

articles.title: Why Anthropic’s Dario Amodei Has Angered OpenAI and Other A.I. Peers
articles.que_paso: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei led his company to lobby the White House against releasing certain AI models, while rival firms Microsoft and Nvidia pushed for openness, drafting a joint letter in late July. After the draft circulated, dozens of firms quickly signed, and within a week another 200, including OpenAI, added their support, highlighting a sharp split in the industry over AI safety versus commercial opportunity.
datos: Dario Amodei is the chief executive of Anthropic.
Anthropic and OpenAI lobbied the White House to block development and wide sharing of specific AI models.
At the end of July, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang exchanged email drafts of a letter urging that the models remain open.
Two dozen companies agreed to the letter before it became public.
Over the next week, 200 additional companies, including OpenAI, signed the letter.
Anthropic is preparing for what is expected to be one of the largest initial public offerings ever, scheduled for later this month.
articles.conclusion: The episode underscores a growing rift between safety‑focused lobbying and profit‑driven openness, and signals Anthropic's rising market clout as it approaches a major IPO.

articles.title: Howard Lutnick Has Got to Go
articles.que_paso: Jensen Huang, Nvidia's chief executive, stepped down after admitting an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence asset, and shortly thereafter the U.S. Commerce Department under Secretary Howard Lutnick chose not to enforce newly‑imposed AI chip export controls, allowing large‑scale smuggling to continue. The decision created a pathway for billions of chips to reach China and Southeast Asian markets despite the Biden administration’s 2025 restrictions.
datos: Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday after acknowledging an extramarital relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.
Howard Lutnick assumed the role of Commerce Secretary in February 2025 and declined to enforce the January 2025 export controls on AI chips.
The January 2025 Biden administration export controls required export licenses for unvetted companies purchasing large AI chips.
Megaspeed allegedly smuggled about $7 billion worth of Nvidia chips into China.
Taiwanese customs data show that from 2025 to 2026 over $60 billion in AI chips were shipped to Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand.
articles.conclusion: The lapse in enforcement has weakened U.S. strategic control over critical AI hardware, highlighting the need for robust, accountable export‑control mechanisms to protect national security.

articles.title: Lauren Boebert Loses Re-election Bid in Colorado House Race to Eileen Laubacher
articles.que_paso: Incumbent Republican Rep. Lauren Boebert was defeated in Colorado’s conservative congressional district by Democrat Eileen Laubacher, a retired Navy rear admiral, after a close vote count. Boebert had switched to this district a few years earlier when her previous seat became more competitive, but the shift was insufficient to retain her seat.
datos: Eileen Laubacher led by more than 3,000 votes when the Associated Press called the race on Friday, November 8, 2026.
Democratic campaign ads in the district totaled over $7 million, according to media‑tracking firm AdImpact.
The ad‑spending ratio favored Democrats at more than 23 to 1 over Republicans.
Lauren Boebert had moved to the district after her former district grew more competitive.
Boebert posted a video on X saying, “Public service was never meant to be a lifetime career…”.
Laubacher is a retired Navy rear admiral and mother of five.
articles.conclusion: The loss shows Democrats can win in traditionally Republican Colorado districts, signaling a shift that could reshape GOP campaign strategies and resource allocation in similar swing areas.

articles.title: Microsoft’s Global Outage and Fixes: What We Know
articles.que_paso: On Thursday around noon Eastern time, Microsoft’s core services—including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot—experienced a worldwide failure that spread to over 70 countries, interrupting communications for schools, government agencies, and businesses. The company’s Redmond‑based team reported recovery progress on Friday and said the cause was a technical issue, not a cyber attack, and that a concurrent FAA ground stop was unrelated.
datos: Outage began at approximately 12:00 PM ET on Thursday, November 13 2026.
Downdetector reported the disruption impacted users in more than 70 countries and territories.
Microsoft said the incident affected “millions of users,” though no exact count was provided.
In its Friday statement, Microsoft confirmed there was “no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity.”
The company described the root cause as “a technical issue not related to cyber or A.I. agents.”
Microsoft noted that the FAA’s nationwide ground stop later Friday afternoon was not linked to the outage.
articles.conclusion: For operations teams, the outage highlights the risk of relying on a single cloud provider for critical communications and the need for contingency plans that can be activated quickly when large‑scale service failures occur.

articles.title: Meet Eileen Laubacher, the Navy Veteran Who Beat Lauren Boebert
articles.que_paso: Eileen Laubacher, a Navy veteran and former Republican running as a Democrat, defeated incumbent Lauren Boebert in Colorado’s most Republican‑leaning congressional district after a grassroots tour of rural towns. The Associated Press announced her victory on Friday, and she began her orientation with other new House members the following Monday.
datos: Laubacher drove approximately 40,000 miles in her campaign car across eastern Colorado’s ranching towns and rural hospitals.
She is a retired Navy rear admiral and a mother of five.
The race was in Colorado’s 3rd congressional district, the state’s most Republican‑leaning district.
The Associated Press declared Laubacher the winner on Friday, November 8, 2026.
She began a House orientation on Monday, November 11, 2026, in Washington.
Her campaign platform included cutting costs, ending former President Trump’s tariffs, and reducing middle‑class taxes.
articles.conclusion: Her win demonstrates that intensive, on‑the‑ground outreach can overturn entrenched partisan strongholds, offering a practical lesson that direct engagement and clear policy proposals can shift voter behavior even in traditionally hostile districts.

articles.title: Mucho más que un castillo: siete pueblos españoles que nacieron al amparo de una fortaleza
articles.que_paso: El artículo describe cómo, en la época medieval, la construcción de castillos en distintas regiones de España dio origen a poblaciones que se desarrollaron alrededor o dentro de sus murallas, formando los núcleos urbanos actuales. Se analizan siete municipios cuyo nacimiento está directamente relacionado con la presencia de una fortaleza, ilustrando el papel estratégico de estos edificios en la configuración del territorio.
datos: Los castillos medievales controlaban territorio, defendían a la población y vigilaban caminos y fronteras.
Alrededor de los castillos surgieron casas, calles y barrios que formaron núcleos urbanos.
En algunos casos, las viviendas se construyeron dentro de las murallas del castillo.
El artículo menciona siete pueblos españoles cuyo origen está ligado a una fortaleza.
articles.conclusion: Este análisis muestra que una infraestructura estratégica puede ser el motor del crecimiento de comunidades, una lección útil para diseñar sistemas operativos y plataformas de IA que requieran una base sólida y controlada para escalar eficientemente.

articles.title: EEUU suspende todos sus vuelos de salida por "motivos de seguridad"
articles.que_paso: El gobierno de EE. UU. ordenó la paralización total de los vuelos de salida desde todos sus aeropuertos, indicando que la medida responde a circunstancias extraordinarias y a motivos de seguridad, y estableció que los aviones deben permanecer en tierra hasta que se emita una nueva autorización.
datos: La suspensión se anunció el viernes 14 de noviembre de 2026.
Afecta a todos los aeropuertos del territorio estadounidense.
La autoridad citó "circunstancias extraordinarias y motivos de seguridad" como causa.
Los vuelos de salida deberán permanecer en tierra hasta nuevo aviso.
articles.conclusion: Esta interrupción masiva afecta la cadena de suministro y la movilidad empresarial, por lo que los operadores deben reprogramar itinerarios y vigilar comunicados oficiales para mitigar interrupciones.

articles.title: Nuclear Assault Have Come To A Definitive End: “There Will Be No Reunions, No Farewell Tours, No Future Live Performances, And No New Studio Recordings”
articles.que_paso: Nuclear Assault, a veteran thrash metal band, issued a formal statement on November 12, 2026 declaring that the group is permanently disbanded. The announcement was made by the four members and confirms the cessation of any future performances, recordings, or reunions, ending a career that spanned over four decades.
datos: The announcement was released on November 12, 2026.
The band said there will be no reunions, farewell tours, future live performances, or new studio recordings.
The statement was signed by Dan Lilker, John Connelly, Anthony Bramante, and Glenn Evan.
Nuclear Assault has been active for more than 40 years, originating from New York City clubs.
Their existing catalog will remain available through remastered releases and videos.
articles.conclusion: The definitive closure eliminates any prospect of new material or tours, so stakeholders should focus on leveraging the existing catalog and legacy for future engagement.

articles.title: Cómo el escándalo sexual del gigante tecnológico Nvidia está salpicando a la Casa Blanca
articles.que_paso: El exdirector de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, fue vinculado a una supuesta relación sentimental con Alice Huang, exejecutiva de Megaspeed en Singapur, lo que ha levantado sospechas de espionaje chino y ha reavivado el debate sobre la efectividad de las restricciones de exportación de chips a China. La revelación ha puesto bajo presión al Departamento de Comercio de EE.UU. y a la junta directiva de Nvidia para esclarecer posibles filtraciones de tecnología sensible.
datos: Jensen Huang se reunió con el presidente Donald Trump en varias ocasiones, viajó con él al Reino Unido y lo acompañó en el Air Force One a China en mayo de 2026
Washington impuso restricciones a la exportación de chips avanzados de Nvidia a China a partir de 2022
Trump autorizó la reanudación de la venta de ciertos chips de Nvidia a China en 2025 a cambio de un porcentaje de los ingresos
Alice Huang, exejecutiva de Megaspeed, es sospechada por la inteligencia estadounidense de tener vínculos con la inteligencia china
Howard Lutnick, secretario de Comercio de EE.UU., recibió un memorándum clasificado sobre la posible desviación de chips a China
Tan Yong Pong (James Tan), CEO de Megaspeed, declaró que la empresa coopera con inspecciones del Departamento de Comercio
articles.conclusion: El caso evidencia vulnerabilidades en el control de exportaciones de tecnología crítica y podría forzar a EE.UU. a endurecer sus políticas para proteger la ventaja competitiva en IA.

articles.title: Inside Microsoft’s Rush to Get Back Online After a Global Outage
articles.que_paso: Late Thursday night a global outage knocked out Microsoft Outlook and other services, forcing hundreds of engineers and senior executives, including Scott Guthrie, to hold an emergency video conference to coordinate recovery; the problem was linked to a recent network upgrade that disabled servers, and the company restored services gradually through Friday.
datos: The outage began late on Thursday, November 13, 2026, and persisted into Friday morning.
Hundreds of Microsoft engineers and top executives participated in an emergency video conference, with senior executive Scott Guthrie leading the discussion.
Affected customers included hospitals, schools, businesses, and Congressional offices in Washington.
Microsoft identified a recent network upgrade that shut down several servers as the root cause.
The company issued at least two public apologies by Friday morning.
Microsoft’s statement said services were restored gradually, validating stability at each stage to avoid a “stampeding herd.”
articles.conclusion: The incident underscores the operational risk of relying on a single provider for critical communication tools and the importance of rigorous change‑management and fallback plans for enterprises.

articles.title: What the choice between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen for Senate leader is all about | Bernie Sanders
articles.que_paso: The Democratic caucus in the U.S. Senate is set to vote on its next leader, with incumbent Majority Leader Chuck Schumer facing a challenge from Senator Chris Van Hollen. Bernie Sanders frames the contest as a decision between preserving the current donor‑driven hierarchy and moving toward a grassroots, policy‑focused party direction.
datos: Chuck Schumer is the incumbent Senate Majority Leader (Democrat) as of 2026
Chris Van Hollen is a Democratic Senator from Maryland and a candidate for Senate Democratic leader
Bernie Sanders, Senator from Vermont, is the ranking member of the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee
The article states that 60% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck
The article claims the United States has the highest rate of childhood poverty among major countries
The article notes the U.S. is the only major country without guaranteed universal healthcare as a human right
articles.conclusion: The leader chosen will steer the Senate’s priorities on campaign finance, AI oversight, health care and other systemic issues, directly influencing how the Democratic Party tackles inequality and policy reform.

articles.title: El Comité de Disciplina sanciona con 12 partidos a Owono por la entrada que costó la vida a Jesús de Miguel
articles.que_paso: El Comité de Disciplina de la RFEF impuso una suspensión de doce partidos al portero andorrano Jesús Owono tras una entrada con la pierna en alto que dejó gravemente herido al delantero del Tenerife, Jesús de Miguel, quien falleció al día siguiente. El hecho ocurrió en el partido de LaLiga Hypermotion jugado el 2 de noviembre en Tenerife, que fue abandonado en el minuto 108 para atender al lesionado.
datos: El partido se disputó el 2 de noviembre de 2026 en el estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López de Tenerife.
Jesús Owono recibió una sanción de doce partidos de suspensión según el artículo 102 del Código Disciplinario de la RFEF.
Jesús de Miguel falleció el 3 de noviembre de 2026 en el Hospital Universitario de Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria.
El choque ocurrió en el minuto 96 del encuentro y el partido se suspendió definitivamente en el minuto 108.
Efe Akman fue sancionado con un partido por acumulación de amonestaciones y Lautaro de León con un partido por doble amonestación.
El entrenador asistente Antonio José Sánchez recibió también una suspensión de un partido por protestar al árbitro.
articles.conclusion: La decisión subraya la intolerancia de la federación ante conductas peligrosas y obliga a los clubes a reforzar la prevención de lesiones graves, recordando que la seguridad de los jugadores es prioritaria sobre la competitividad.

articles.title: Nvidia Scandal Unleashes a Flood of AI-Generated Memes
articles.que_paso: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia’s CEO after a series of cheating scandals, prompting a wave of AI‑generated memes that remix his image across music videos, Bollywood films, sitcoms and concert footage. The memes, created by AI enthusiasts, quickly spread online, turning the personal controversy into a viral cultural phenomenon.
datos: Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday, November 12, 2026.
He is 63 years old.
Nvidia sold 178 sweaters featuring a pixel‑art likeness of Huang earlier in 2026.
The alleged affair involves a woman the U.S. government considers a Chinese spy.
Belgian software engineer Peter Dedene superimposed Huang’s image on a Coldplay kiss‑cam and gave a phone interview on Thursday.
articles.conclusion: The episode illustrates how readily AI tools can magnify executive misconduct into widespread brand damage, so operations leaders must anticipate and manage AI‑driven reputation risks.

articles.title: Las memorias de Nacho Duato desencadenado: entre el novio que dejó por ver una película de Torrente y el lado duro de la vida
articles.que_paso: Nacho Duato, coreógrafo reconocido, inició la campaña de difusión de su nuevo libro en su ciudad natal, Valencia, junto a su amiga de la infancia y poeta Lupe Bohorques. La obra, “Habla como un hombre”, incluye una anécdota sobre la ruptura con su novio, quien la dejó para ver una película de Torrente, mostrando el lado más duro de su vida.
datos: Nacho Duato es el autor principal del libro “Habla como un hombre”.
El libro fue escrito en colaboración con Lupe Bohorques, amiga de la infancia y poeta.
La promoción del libro comenzó en Valencia, ciudad natal de Duato.
El título del libro es “Habla como un hombre”.
En la obra se relata que su novio la abandonó para ver una película de la saga Torrente.
articles.conclusion: La incursión de Duato en la escritura personal amplía su presencia mediática y demuestra cómo una narrativa íntima puede reforzar la conexión con el público, una estrategia útil para cualquier líder que busque diversificar su marca personal.

articles.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
articles.que_paso: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its Dots agents to make purchases on a user’s behalf after the user adds a payment card, but each transaction must be approved with a biometric check before checkout. The feature is limited to retailers that do not block AI agents, and OpenAI plans to let users set spending limits and pre‑approve purchase categories in the future.
datos: ChatGPT Wallet requires a biometric security check (Face ID or fingerprint) for every purchase, according to OpenAI’s support page.
Payments are processed using a token that replaces the user’s credit‑card details, similar to Apple Pay or Google Wallet.
OpenAI intends to let users delegate purchases by setting spending limits, approved categories, or time‑based parameters.
Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse agents earlier in 2026, illustrating retailer resistance to AI‑driven transactions.
OpenAI states that websites must ensure agents are not blocked and that payment‑risk systems recognize legitimate agent purchases.
articles.conclusion: The wallet could streamline procurement for operations teams, but it adds security and compliance layers that require careful policy and risk‑management review before delegating purchases to AI agents.

articles.title: Atlas Premiere Their New Single “Sex Magic Eclipse”
articles.que_paso: Finnish Northcore band Atlas released a new single titled “Sex Magic Eclipse” with a visualizer/lyric video produced by Riivata Visuals, following their February album “Sunder.” The release continues the group’s output after the full‑length album earlier this year.
datos: Band: Atlas, a Finnish Northcore outfit
Single title: “Sex Magic Eclipse”
Video created by Riivata Visuals as a visualizer/lyric video
Album “Sunder” released in February 2026
First new release after the February album
articles.conclusion: The rollout illustrates how niche artists use visual content to keep audiences engaged between album cycles, a strategy that can be applied to product launches for sustained interest.

articles.title: Euromillones: comprobar sorteo del viernes 13 de noviembre
articles.que_paso: El sorteo de Euromillones se celebra este viernes 13 de noviembre, manteniendo el bote garantizado tras la entrega del premio especial en el sorteo anterior. El juego sigue operando en varios países europeos y ofrece un premio adicional de un millón de euros a los boletos españoles que coincidan con el código de “El Millón”.
datos: Bote garantizado de 17 millones de euros para el sorteo del viernes 13 de noviembre
El martes anterior se repartió el bote especial a un ganador de Valencia
El Euromillones se juega en España, Francia, Reino Unido, Austria, Bélgica, Irlanda, Luxemburgo, Portugal y Suiza
El juego se lanzó en 2004
Cada martes y viernes se sortea un premio de 1 millón de euros entre los boletos vendidos en territorio español
Los resultados se publican en la web de Loterías y Apuestas del Estado y también en EL PAÍS
articles.conclusion: El bote garantizado y el premio diario de un millón refuerzan el atractivo del Euromillones, lo que puede traducirse en mayor venta de boletos y oportunidades de colaboración comercial en los mercados participantes.

articles.title: CMF’s milk carton-shaped Bluetooth speaker is down to a new low price
articles.que_paso: Nothing introduced a milk‑carton‑shaped Bluetooth speaker in October and is now promoting it with a deep discount ahead of Black Friday, selling it through Amazon and the company’s own store.
datos: The CMF Speaker S is priced at $39, a $20 reduction from its original price
It launched in October 2026
The speaker offers up to 18 hours of playback on a single charge
It carries an IP68 rating for water and dust resistance
It uses a 45 mm driver with two passive radiators for low‑frequency response
Bluetooth version 6 is supported, with fast pairing via NFC and Google Fast Pair
articles.conclusion: The aggressive pricing makes a uniquely designed, feature‑rich speaker affordable for office or personal use, highlighting Nothing’s strategy to capture early‑season demand.

articles.title: Un petrolero hunde un ferry de pasajeros en el río Misisipi, de momento sin víctimas
articles.que_paso: El viernes 14 de noviembre de 2026 un petrolero colisionó con un ferry de pasajeros en el río Misisipi, justo a la altura del puerto de Nueva Orleans. El impacto provocó que el ferry se hundiera, aunque hasta el momento no se han registrado fallecidos.
datos: Fecha del incidente: viernes 14 de noviembre de 2026
Lugar: río Misisipi, cerca del puerto de Nueva Orleans
Embarcaciones involucradas: un petrolero y un ferry de pasajeros
Resultado inmediato: el ferry quedó sumergido
Estado de víctimas: sin constancia de fallecidos hasta el momento
articles.conclusion: El suceso evidencia riesgos de navegación en vías fluviales concurridas y obliga a revisar protocolos de seguridad y respuesta ante colisiones para minimizar pérdidas humanas y ambientales.

articles.title: Why Jensen Huang Was Essential to Nvidia’s Rise
articles.que_paso: The article profiles Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, describing his hands‑on leadership and the company's absence of a clear succession plan, as reported by technology journalist Tripp Mickle. It situates Huang’s influence within the broader growth of the artificial‑intelligence sector.
datos: Jensen Huang had 60 direct reports at Nvidia.
Nvidia has no publicly announced succession plan for Huang.
The piece was written by Tripp Mickle, a technology reporter.
The article examines Huang’s central role in Nvidia and the AI industry.
The article title is "Why Jensen Huang Was Essential to Nvidia’s Rise".
articles.conclusion: The concentration of authority and lack of succession planning highlight a governance risk for a company driving AI innovation, suggesting operators should monitor leadership continuity. Understanding this dynamic helps anticipate potential strategic shifts.

articles.title: Coheed And Cambria’s Claudio Sanchez Announces His Upcoming Solo Debut
articles.que_paso: Claudio Sanchez, the vocalist and guitarist of Coheed and Cambria, announced on November 13 that he will begin a solo career, stating he will release his first solo material after 25 years with the band. The announcement followed a series of social‑media teasers and did not include details about the release schedule or content.
datos: Claudio Sanchez is the vocalist/guitarist of Coheed and Cambria
The announcement was made on November 13, 2026
Sanchez said, “After 25 years of Coheed, I’m finally going to release my first solo material… Here come the nerves…”.
He has been with Coheed for 25 years
No release date or tracklist has been disclosed yet
The announcement was preceded by a series of social‑media teasers
articles.conclusion: Sanchez’s solo launch signals a new revenue stream and brand extension for the artist, and fans should watch for upcoming release details that could affect touring and merchandising plans.

articles.title: In elephants, the resilience of communities has its limits
articles.que_paso: A twelve‑year study of Asian elephants in Sri Lanka’s Udawalawe National Park, led by behavioral ecologist Anastasia Madsen and senior author Shermin de Silva, showed that when elephant deaths consistently outnumbered new arrivals, the previously cohesive female social network broke apart into smaller, isolated groups. The researchers tracked the herd by identifying individual females from their distinctive ear markings while driving park roads three days a week.
datos: The research spanned 2007 to 2018, covering 12 years of observations.
443 adult and subadult female elephants were individually identified during the study period.
Udawalawe National Park was established in the 1970s around a reservoir that initially created extensive grassland.
Invasive plant species such as lantana later overran parts of the park, creating thickets that elephants avoid due to lack of forage.
Shermin de Silva initiated the Udawalawe Elephant Research Project in 2006.
The team recorded observations on random routes about three days per week.
articles.conclusion: The findings reveal that elephant societies have a finite capacity for social resilience, highlighting the need for conservation strategies that ensure sufficient recruitment and maintain habitat quality to prevent social fragmentation.

articles.title: Early Black Friday Mattress Deals: Get Up to 55% Off WIRED-Tested Favorites
articles.que_paso: Early Black Friday promotions are now live for several WIRED‑tested mattress brands, each offering distinct discount codes and percentages ahead of the main holiday weekend, with the offers updated on November 13, 2026. articles.title: Wall Street Loses a Powerful Dealmaker After Nvidia’s CEO Is Ousted
articles.que_paso: Jensen Huang was abruptly removed as CEO of Nvidia, ending his role as the company's chief dealmaker. His departure raises concerns on Wall Street about the future pace of Nvidia’s massive AI‑related investments and the fees they generate for financial firms.
datos: Jensen Huang was ousted from Nvidia this week (November 2026).
His deals pumped "hundreds of billions of dollars" into competitors, suppliers and customers.
Nvidia was spending or promising money at an unprecedented speed and magnitude until this week.
Michael Edwards, director of Forum Markets, said "Nvidia is the central bank of A.I."
The Trump administration provided warm regulatory support for the AI chip industry.
articles.conclusion: Without Huang’s deal‑making engine, Nvidia’s investment tempo may slow, reducing the flow of high‑fee opportunities for banks and potentially tempering AI sector growth.

articles.title: Kalshi ditches Trump Jr. as advisor; CEO admitted "optics" weren't good
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump Jr. terminated his advisory position at prediction‑market platform Kalshi after his venture firm 1789 Capital made a large investment in Polymarket, Kalshi's rival. The separation was mutually agreed, with Kalshi citing a conflict‑of‑interest and optics problem stemming from the dual advisory roles.
datos: Donald Trump Jr.'s firm 1789 Capital invested $300 million in Polymarket in August 2026, following a smaller investment in August 2025.
Trump Jr. received roughly $300,000 of Kalshi equity when he joined as a strategic adviser in early 2025.
Kalshi was valued at under $2 billion at the time of the equity grant, compared with a $22 billion valuation in a funding round reported last month.
Kalshi is reportedly negotiating a new funding round that could value the company at $65 billion.
Kalshi announced Trump Jr.'s advisory appointment on 13 January 2025, a week before Donald Trump's second inauguration.
CFTC has sued 11 states to block state regulation of prediction markets and filed briefs supporting Kalshi in related lawsuits.
articles.conclusion: The split highlights the importance of managing conflicts of interest as prediction‑market firms scale and attract massive capital, and it signals that regulatory and reputational scrutiny will increasingly shape governance decisions.

articles.title: Sister June Carpenter, the Oldest Shaker, Has Died
articles.que_paso: Sister June Carpenter, a librarian and one of the three remaining practicing Shakers, died on November 3, 2026, leaving the Sabbathday Lake community with only two active members. Her passing intensifies concerns about the survival of the last active Shaker group in the United States.
datos: Sister June Carpenter died on November 3, 2026, at age 88.
At the time of her death she was one of three practicing members of the Sabbathday Lake Shaker Village.
The Shaker village is located in New Gloucester, Maine, and covers roughly 1,800 acres of farmland, woods, and wetlands.
After her death only two practicing Shakers remain: Brother Arnold Hadd, age 70, and Sister April Baxter, about 60 years old.
A 2006 Boston Globe story titled “The Last Man Standing” led Brother Wayne Smith to leave the community.
articles.conclusion: The loss underscores how close the Shaker tradition is to disappearing, urging stakeholders to prioritize preservation or documentation before the community vanishes.

articles.title: Why the Nvidia scandal is far from over - The Latest
articles.que_paso: Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO of Nvidia amid allegations of personal misconduct involving a company executive and a woman identified as a potential Chinese intelligence asset. The resignation has triggered criticism of U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for perceived inaction, and the issue is being discussed in a Guardian interview with Lucy Hough and reporter Aisha Down.
datos: Jensen Huang was the founder and chief executive of Nvidia before resigning.
The alleged misconduct involves an Nvidia executive and a woman described as a Chinese spy.
U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been publicly criticized for not taking decisive steps.
Lucy Hough conducted the interview with Guardian technology reporter Aisha Down.

articles.conclusion: The episode underscores heightened regulatory and reputational risk for AI‑hardware firms, indicating that investors and policymakers will scrutinize corporate governance and national‑security ties more closely.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 Crawls Back to Life After a 24-Hour Outage
articles.que_paso: On Thursday, November 12, 2026, Microsoft 365 suffered a global outage that disabled Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other core services for tens of millions of users. The disruption began around noon Eastern Time in North America and rapidly spread to more than 70 countries, affecting businesses, governments and critical infrastructure.
datos: The outage started at approximately 12:00 pm ET on Thursday, 12 Nov 2026.
Service disruption spanned over 70 countries and impacted tens of millions of Microsoft 365 users.
Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack and AI/agents, attributing the cause to a network capacity upgrade issue.
Microsoft extended the email delivery queue to 48 hours to process messages sent during the outage.
Governments from Japan to the United States, airlines, law‑enforcement agencies and hospitals reported operational disruptions.
Microsoft pledged to publish a full post‑incident report after the review.
articles.conclusion: The event underscores the operational risk of heavy reliance on a single cloud provider for essential communications, urging organizations to strengthen redundancy and incident‑response strategies.

articles.title: Kingdom Of Giants’ “Past Life” Music Video Debuts Alongside Their New Album “Usurper”
articles.que_paso: Kingdom Of Giants released their fifth studio album Usurper on November 13, 2026, introducing JT Gutierrez as the new bassist and clean vocalist. Simultaneously they launched a music video for the closing track “Past Life,” directed by Orie McGinness, and announced a North‑American fall tour beginning the next day.
datos: Album “Usurper” release date: November 13, 2026.

Music video for “Past Life” directed by Orie McGinness (formerly of Bad Omens, Poppy).

articles.title: Memoriam’s “At The Point Of No Return” Reflects On The Cost Of War
articles.que_paso: British death‑metal band Memoriam released the online premiere of their new track “At The Point Of No Return,” which serves as a thematic preview for their announced final studio album “Endgame.” Vocalist Karl Willets explained that the song reflects his frustration with ongoing global conflicts and the personal toll of war, framing the release as a concluding statement for the group.
datos: The track “At The Point Of No Return” premiered online on November 14, 2026.
Memoriam’s final album “Endgame” is scheduled for release on January 29, 2027, via Reaper Entertainment.
The band’s lineup includes former members of Bolt Thrower and Annihilator.
Vocalist Karl Willets is quoted saying the song “comes from a feeling that has become increasingly difficult to shake” regarding world conflict.
Memoriam announced that “Endgame” will be their last studio album.
articles.conclusion: The release signals both a creative endpoint for the band and a stark artistic commentary on the human cost of war, illustrating how leaders can use cultural outputs to highlight operational risks and moral considerations.

articles.title: Los servicios de Microsoft retoman la normalidad tras una caída global de más de 18 horas

Los servicios afectados incluyeron Outlook, Teams y Copilot.

articles.title: Trump Signals New Strategy on Iran: A Waiting Game
articles.que_paso: President Trump announced a shift toward declaring the Iran nuclear crisis resolved, abandoning previously discussed military options such as commando raids and bunker‑buster strikes. datos: President Trump said the US no longer needs a new nuclear agreement or missile‑limitation deal with Iran
The plan to seize roughly 970 pounds of uranium enriched to 60% purity has been dropped
Analysis of whether US bunker‑busters could reach the alleged Pickaxe Mountain centrifuge site was abandoned
Marco Rubio made the statement in Paris during a G7 foreign‑minister meeting
Rubio claimed the economic campaign against Iran is “working so well” that major combat operations are unnecessary
articles.conclusion: The pivot to strategic patience signals a reliance on sanctions over direct military action, reshaping US‑Iran engagement and affecting operational planning for any future escalation.

articles.title: You can adjust the position of the trackball on Keychron’s new wireless mouse

articles.title: El papa León XIV se reencuentra con su pueblo de Chiclayo
articles.que_paso: El Papa León XIV volvió a Chiclayo para reunirse con la población local, marcando la fase más emotiva de su gira por Sudamérica.

articles.title: If Gen Z are asked to go to war, it might not be in the way they expect | Brief letters
articles.que_paso: The newspaper’s Brief letters section published a set of reader contributions covering several unrelated topics: a view that Gen Z is unlikely to volunteer for conventional war and might instead be drawn into a NATO conflict on Russia’s border; a report that Starbucks intends to add thousands of UK staff; a criticism of Netanyahu’s call for Israel to become a “super Sparta”; and nostalgic recollections about homemade itching powder and a comic‑book reference. The letters were submitted by individuals from various UK towns and dated in early November.
datos: Jason Okundaye’s letter, dated 10 November, argues that Britain’s youth do not relish going to war and may be asked to fight for a NATO ally on Russia’s border.
Matthew J Smith cites Starbucks plans to hire 7,500 staff in a major UK expansion, referenced in a 9 November letter.
Philip Clarke references an editorial on 12 November stating that Netanyahu wants Israel to become a “super Sparta.”
Peter Brooker’s 12 November letter mentions collecting rosehip seeds to make itching powder.
Stephen Walkley, aged 77¾, recalls reading about “itchy” powder in the Beano comic at age 11, as noted in his 12 November submission.
The collection of letters appeared in the Brief letters column on 12 November 2026.
articles.conclusion: The pieces highlight generational reluctance toward traditional combat, a sizable retail hiring surge, and the influence of political rhetoric, underscoring the need for operations leaders to monitor workforce sentiment, talent pipelines, and public opinion when planning strategy.

articles.title: La UE no logra elegir una única voz y enviará representantes de cinco países a las conversaciones de paz
articles.que_paso: Los líderes de la UE no lograron acordar un portavoz único para las negociaciones de paz entre Ucrania y Rusia y, en su lugar, decidieron enviar un equipo conjunto de representantes de la propia UE y de cinco estados miembros. La falta de consenso refleja divisiones internas sobre la estrategia europea en el conflicto.
datos: El anuncio se hizo el viernes 14 de noviembre de 2026.
No se designó una sola voz para las conversaciones patrocinadas por Estados Unidos.
El equipo europeo incluirá representantes de las instituciones de la UE y de Alemania, Francia, Reino Unido, Italia y Polonia.
Las negociaciones son entre Ucrania y Rusia y están auspiciadas por EE. UU.
La decisión implica que cinco países participarán directamente en lugar de un portavoz único.
articles.conclusion: Esta dispersión de la representación europea puede reducir la influencia de la UE en la mediación y obliga a coordinar posiciones entre varios estados para lograr un impacto efectivo.

articles.title: US Prostate Cancer Guidelines Updated For First Time Since 2010. Here's What You Need to Know
articles.que_paso: The United States released its first revision of prostate‑cancer screening guidelines since 2010, setting a universal biennial testing schedule for men aged 50 and older and altering the start age and interval for groups deemed at higher risk.
datos: The guidelines are the first update since the 2010 version
Men aged 50 + are advised to undergo prostate screening every two years
The schedule and starting age are changed for men classified as at‑risk
The recommendations apply to U.S. clinical practice
articles.conclusion: The change standardizes screening for the majority while prompting targeted protocols for higher‑risk patients, enabling more efficient allocation of resources in health operations.

articles.title: Las secadoras de Whirlpool estrenan Adaptive Dry: así es la función que aprende cómo te gusta la ropa tras cada ciclo
articles.que_paso: Whirlpool ha incorporado la función Adaptive Dry a sus secadoras conectadas, permitiendo que el aparato aprenda de las valoraciones del usuario tras cada uso y ajuste automáticamente parámetros como temperatura y tiempo. La herramienta se gestiona a través de la aplicación móvil HomeWhiz, cerrando el ciclo de retroalimentación sin que el cliente tenga que programar manualmente cada carga.
datos: Whirlpool lanzó Adaptive Dry como una función de aprendizaje automático en sus secadoras conectadas
La función se integra con la app móvil HomeWhiz para recibir valoraciones del usuario
El modelo mencionado es una secadora Whirlpool de bomba de calor de 8 kg, referencia C WD 84M WBS SPT
Los usuarios pueden calificar tres variables clave del resultado de cada ciclo desde la app

articles.title: Millions Of Baby Crabs Made An Epic “Twice-In-A-Decade” Return To Christmas Island Last Year: “It Is Literally Like The Floor Is Lava"
articles.que_paso: A new wildlife documentary released showing a massive migration of baby Christmas Island red crabs that occurred last year, marking the first such event in ten years. The film follows a crab named "Frank" as the larvae emerge and flood the island's forest floor.
datos: Millions of baby crabs migrated on Christmas Island
The migration was the first of its kind in a decade
It took place during the 2025 breeding season (last year)
The event was captured in a newly released wildlife documentary
One observer described the scene as "literally like the floor is lava"
articles.conclusion: The unprecedented crab surge highlights the resilience of the island's ecosystem and underscores the value of documenting such events for conservation planning.

articles.title: Stanford Scientists Intrigued by Method for Bringing Bleached Coral Back to Life
articles.que_paso: Stanford marine biologists led by Steve Palumbi discovered that bleached coral fragments can recover when they are placed in direct contact with healthy coral, a finding prompted by a lab accident. In a controlled test, the touching fragments regained color within weeks, suggesting a simple physical fusion method could aid reef restoration after bleaching events.
datos: The experiment used ten bleached coral fragments; five were placed touching healthy fragments and five were kept a few millimeters apart.
The touching fragments regained color and survived after seven weeks, while the separated fragments died of starvation.
Microscopic analysis showed algae transferred to the bleached fragments within one week, proliferating at a rate about ten times faster than in natural conditions.
Almost 10 % of the world’s coral reefs have been lost over the past 30 years.
The findings were reported in a paper published in the journal Science Advances.
Researchers quoted include Stanford professor Steve Palumbi, PhD student Danny Collins, and coauthor Fiorenza Micheli.
articles.conclusion: The technique provides a rapid, low‑tech option to revive bleached corals after heatwaves, but it does not mitigate the underlying temperature rise, so it should be used as a targeted post‑event restoration tool.

articles.title: La ciencia pone en duda que sea posible resucitar animales extintos como el mamut o el lobo terrible
articles.que_paso: Un artículo de opinión en Biology Letters, escrito por Andrew Davinack y Charlotte K. Daniels, critica la afirmación de Colossal Biosciences de haber 'resucitado' al lobo terrible mediante edición genética de lobos grises, argumentando que la identidad de especie depende de la continuidad poblacional y la historia evolutiva, no solo del genoma. Señalan que los animales creados poseen rasgos inferidos del depredador extinto, pero carecen de una reconstrucción completa de su linaje.
datos: Los autores del artículo son Andrew Davinack y Charlotte K. Daniels y fue publicado en la revista Biology Letters.
El lobo terrible (Aenocyon dirus) se extinguió a finales del Pleistoceno y su linaje se separó del lobo gris (Canis lupus) hace aproximadamente 5,7 millones de años.
Colossal Biosciences introdujo 20 modificaciones distribuidas en 14 genes de células de lobo gris para producir los ejemplares.
Los animales resultantes fueron gestados en madres sustitutas mediante clonación, pero sin una reconstrucción completa del genoma del lobo terrible.
articles.conclusion: El análisis muestra que la edición de genes aislados no equivale a restaurar una especie extinta, lo que implica que proyectos de desextinción deben ser evaluados con cautela antes de destinar recursos operacionales.

articles.title: Al menos 50 heridos en un ataque ruso sobre la provincia ucraniana de Zaporiyia
articles.que_paso: Un ataque con artillería rusa golpeó un bloque de viviendas en el distrito de Kosmichni, provincia de Zaporiyia, dejando a cincuenta personas heridas, según informó el gobernador interino Mijailo Semikin. El incidente se produjo en medio de intensos combates en la región sur de Ucrania.
datos: Número de heridos: 50
Gobernador interino de Zaporiyia: Mijailo Semikin
Ubicación del ataque: edificio residencial en el distrito de Kosmichni, provincia de Zaporiyia
Autor del ataque: fuerzas militares rusas
Fecha de la declaración: 14 de noviembre de 2026
articles.conclusion: El ataque subraya la vulnerabilidad de la población civil en Zaporiyia y la necesidad de reforzar la protección de zonas residenciales en los conflictos.
